Promptr Studio Pro 5.75

  • Small reference videos are upscaled instead of rejected. Clips below Seedance's minimum of 407,696 pixels, such as 848×480, are scaled to 720p size automatically when you attach them.
  • Seedance 2.5 combined length is 30 seconds. Up to ten reference videos may total 30 seconds, matching the provider documentation. Single clips stay at 30 seconds, Seedance 2.0 keeps 15.
  • Pixel limits follow the provider documentation. The minimum is now 407,696 pixels instead of 409,600, so Seedance's own 480p output is always accepted.

Promptr Studio Pro 5.74

  • Clear failure cards. A failed generation now shows what happened, why, and what to do next. Codes and raw provider text stay behind "Details" with a copy button.
  • Seedance 2.5 reference videos up to 30 seconds. Clips are no longer trimmed to 14 seconds, and there is no combined length limit for this model. Seedance 2.0 keeps its 15 second rule.
  • Realistic 3D asset pack. 23 CC0 models ship with the app: building shells, facade modules, a covered car, two body bases and twelve clothed people, ready for the 3D library offline.
  • Camera pan and tilt, obstacle avoidance. Aim the camera with a live preview, and let camera routes avoid static geometry in the routes editor and through 3D Paul.
  • Character rigging prepared. The workflow for rigging your own humanoid GLB is in place and will be enabled with an upcoming backend update.

Promptr Studio Pro 5.73

  • Scene templates and building blocks. Start a 3D scene from a street, living room, dialogue or car interior template, and assemble sets from twelve road and room modules.
  • Object library with starter assets. Import GLB models, search by category, calibrate real-world sizes and reuse instances. Eight stylised starter models are included.
  • Character clips and drawn camera paths. Play bundled motion clips on figures, and sketch camera moves in a floor plan with height, timing and a preview before applying.
  • 3D Paul camera work. Framing for several subjects at once, subject tracking, and targeted shot edits that leave the rest of the animation untouched.
  • Meshy V7 and SAM 3 Body. 3D object and person generation from a still image is now available.
  • Cleaner composer layout. Toolbars and side panels adapt to the window width. Fixed the bottom of the composer being cut off at small window heights.
